column3: “Locusts” is rendered “a locust-swarm”; “at the beginning of the coming up of the spring-crop” is rendered “when the spring crop began to sprout,” and “mowings” “mowing.”
“Forgive” is rendered “pardon,” and “who will he stand” “How can Jacob stand.”
“Relented on this” is rendered “changed His mind about this.”
“Calling for conducting a case by fire” is rendered “calling to contend with them by fire”; “the portion of land” is rendered “the farm land,” and NASB adds “began to.”
The Hebrew word glossed “tin” is rendered “vertical wall” and “plumb line”; the meaning of the word is uncertain.
“Tin” is rendered “plumb line”; “not I will repeat again to pass by it” is rendered “I will spare them no longer.”
“From on its land” is placed before “into exile.”
“There you will prophesy” is rendered “there do your prophesying!”
“A sanctuary of a king” is rendered “a sanctuary of the king,” and “a house of kingdom” “a royal residence”; “Bethel” is rendered “at Bethel.”
“I was” is rendered “I am”; “a fig picker of sycamores” is rendered “a grower of sycamore figs.”
“From after the flock” is rendered “from following the flock.”
The second “prophesy” renders a different Hebrew verb (“drip, preach”); NASB renders it “speak.”
“Divided” is rendered “parceled up,” and “ground unclean” “unclean soil”; NASB adds “Moreover.”
